clips.title: The story
paras: At Stonewrought Dam, Chief Engineer Hinderweir VII suspects sabotage and sends volatile powder north for examination. A courier must carry it through the perilous Wetlands to demolition expert Ashlan Stonesmirk at Dun Modr.

A strange-smelling powder came from a suspicious barrel near the Stonewrought Dam’s eastern ramp, where Hinderweir had spotted Dark Iron sappers. Disturbances around the dam have put the chief engineer on alert. He suspects the powder is a refined explosive meant to shatter dwarven masonry, but the dam has no specialized equipment to test it. Before he draws a firm conclusion, he wants a military demolitionist to examine the sample.

The journey leads through the Algaz Gate and down into the sodden lowlands of the Wetlands. Hostile wildlife, aggressive dragonkin, and Dark Iron infiltrators make the route dangerous. Hinderweir urges travelers to stay on the cobbled road to Dun Modr, a pillaged dwarven town at the southern approach to the Thandol Span. An Ironforge regiment still guards the town.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: If my suspicions are correct, this is some type of explosive powder. This must be analyzed by an explosives expert so we know just what we're dealing with here. Ashlan Stonesmirk was assigned to the regiment guarding Dun Modr and the Thandol Span. I need you to make a grave and perilous journey, friend.
Travel through the Algaz Gate, follow the road through the Wetlands and seek out Stonesmirk in Dun Modr. Heed my advice: stick to the roads and stop for nothing!

clips.title: Progress
paras: You say somethin', kid? Can't hear a bloody thing besides the ringin' in me ears. Say, what's that you got there?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, well Ol' Hinderweir is wise to be worried.
